title: Flood Monitoring and Prediction System for Mexico
description: Developed during an internship at Mirai Innovation Research Institute in Osaka, Japan. The system utilizes AWS services for data ingestion, processing, and real-time visualization to monitor and predict flood events, aiming to mitigate their impact in vulnerable regions of Mexico. Integrated IoT technologies for data collection.

title: HackUTP Official Platform (hackutp.com)
description: Developed and deployed the official website and platform for HackUTP 2025. The platform managed registrations, information dissemination, and potentially project submissions. Implemented with CI/CD pipelines using AWS Elastic Beanstalk.

title: Cadenas by St. Joseph Website (cadenasbystjoseph.com)
description: Freelance project involving the end-to-end development of a website for a client. The solution included a scalable architecture using WordPress, Firebase Authentication for user management, Google Drive API for content, Cloudflare for performance/security, and hosting on AWS Lightsail. Automated content publishing features were key deliverables.

title: SmartWaste Vision
description: An intelligent waste classification system designed for Mexico, developed for the ANUIES4MX Challenge. The project aimed to improve recycling rates and waste management efficiency through technology.

title: Cybersecurity Incident Management System
description: Developed for LoboHackathon 2024 (Converge Category). This system provides real-time alerts and management capabilities for cybersecurity incidents, utilizing AWS Amplify and SNS for critical data flow and notifications. It was designed to improve emergency response times to digital threats.
place: Benemerita Universidad Autonoma de Puebla, Puebla, Mexico

title: Energy Control Mobile App
description: Developed for HackMorelos 2024. A mobile application designed to help reduce energy consumption during peak hours by providing smart notifications and real-time data analysis. Implemented using AWS Amplify and SNS to promote conscious energy use.
place: Tecnologico de Monterrey, Cuernavaca, Morelos, Mexico
